newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton prices down on subdued demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton prices down on subdued demand.

text.p: Cotton prices fell on Tuesday on subdued demand from mills, traders said.
They said international prices of yarn were down and this in turn affected local mills producing and exporting yarn.
"Cotton buying by the yarn mills was low," said a trader. "Unless the world yarn market improves the local mill buying cannot pick up."
In spot, Gujarat Kalyan lost 200 rupees to 13,300 rupees per candy (355.56 kg). Gujarat Wagad was steady at 12,600 rupees per candy.
